items.html: Also a second reason, as is known: for HGT are called fathers and NHY are called sons; therefore her NHY are called stones, after the sons. Also a third reason: for her NHY are what return to become the aspect of the very body for ZON, who are the sons of Tvuna, when they clothe within him together with the Mochin, as mentioned. And from their very substance, ZA grows in the second Gadlut, and also now he grows through them in the Mochin of Yenika. Therefore her NHY are called stones, because from them is made the aspect of the very body of the sons. And this is the secret that the Torah, which is ZA, endures only through Mi, which is Tvuna, who kills her very self and her NHY for the sake of the Torah, to sustain it and to clothe within it in the aspect of the Mochin, as mentioned.
